row_number:
SELECT fruit, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY quantity DESC) AS position
FROM (VALUES ('apples', 12), ('pears', 8)) AS data(fruit, quantity);
rank:
SELECT quantity, rank() OVER (ORDER BY quantity DESC) AS position
FROM (VALUES (12), (12), (8)) AS data(quantity);
dense_rank:
SELECT quantity, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY quantity DESC) AS position
FROM (VALUES (12), (12), (8)) AS data(quantity);
first_value:
SELECT fruit, first_value(fruit) OVER (ORDER BY quantity DESC) AS best_seller
FROM (VALUES ('apples', 12), ('pears', 8)) AS data(fruit, quantity);
lag:
SELECT quantity, lag(quantity) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS previous
FROM (VALUES (1, 12), (2, 8), (3, 15)) AS data(day, quantity);
lead:
SELECT quantity, lead(quantity) OVER (ORDER BY day) AS next
FROM (VALUES (1, 12), (2, 8), (3, 15)) AS data(day, quantity);
countif:
SELECT countif(quantity > 10) AS large_orders
FROM (VALUES (8), (12), (20)) AS data(quantity);
bitstring_agg:
SELECT bitstring_agg(value, 1, 5) AS present
FROM (VALUES (1), (3), (5)) AS data(value);
create_sort_key: SELECT create_sort_key('apples', 'DESC NULLS LAST') AS sort_key;
nextval:
CREATE OR REPLACE SEQUENCE example_sequence START 1;
SELECT nextval('example_sequence') AS next_id;
enum_code:
CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE example_mood AS ENUM ('sad', 'neutral', 'happy');
SELECT enum_code('happy'::example_mood) AS result;
enum_first:
CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE example_mood AS ENUM ('sad', 'neutral', 'happy');
SELECT enum_first(NULL::example_mood) AS result;
enum_last:
CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE example_mood AS ENUM ('sad', 'neutral', 'happy');
SELECT enum_last(NULL::example_mood) AS result;
enum_range:
CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE example_mood AS ENUM ('sad', 'neutral', 'happy');
SELECT enum_range(NULL::example_mood) AS result;
enum_range_boundary:
CREATE OR REPLACE TYPE example_mood AS ENUM ('sad', 'neutral', 'happy');
SELECT enum_range_boundary('neutral'::example_mood, 'happy'::example_mood) AS result;
